code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    color = max(set(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts), key=lambda v: sum(grid[r][c] == v for r,c in pts))
    r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): out[r][c]=color
    for c in range(c0+1,c1):
        rs=[r for r,cc in pts if cc==c]
        if len(rs)>=2:
            for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1): out[r][c]=color
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        cs=[c for rr,c in pts if rr==r]
        if len(cs)>=2:
            for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1): out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
